body.ruleText:
rule dac_win_0016 {
  meta:
    author = "DaC"
    description = "Password reset attempts spike (4724) by actor - Detects spikes in password reset attempts which can indicate account takeover or helpdesk abuse."
    severity = "High"
    rule_id = "DAC-WIN-0016"
    source_language = "spl"
    converted_by = "rulebridge"
    mitre_attack_technique = "T1098"

  events:
    $e.metadata.log_type = "WINEVTLOG"
    $e.metadata.product_event_type = "4724"
    $user = $e.principal.user.userid
    $name = $e.principal.hostname

  match:
    $user, $name over 1h

  outcome:
    $resets = count($e.metadata.id)
    $users = count_distinct($e.target.user.userid)
    $user_list = array_distinct($e.target.user.userid)

  condition:
    $e and $resets >= 5 and $users >= 5
}
